plainText:
Kōji Ishii (Japanese: 石井康嗣 Ishii Kōji) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Ishii was born on July 1, 1960, in , , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He first voiced the minor role of a during the of the . He then voiced the antagonistic Colonel Hansen during . Ishii is currently affiliated with the talent agency Vi-Vo.
